summary.text: Josh Hastings is the Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 38B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Barry Beauchamp.
He is a Wicomico County councilmember and the founder of Sound Mind Strategies, an agricultural, environmental and natural resources consulting firm, according to his Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Hastings earned a high school diploma from Mardela High School, a bachelor's degree from Salisbury University in 2004, and a graduate degree from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County in 2017, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he holds two bachelor's degrees from Salisbury University, in business and political science, a master's degree in public policy from UMBC, and a certificate in Strategic Management from Georgetown University.
He said he spent 15 years working within Maryland conservation nonprofits before founding Sound Mind Strategies.
Hastings said he served two years as chair of the Rural Maryland Council and chairs the Local Government Advisory Committee of the Chesapeake Bay Executive Council.
He said he received the Maryland Sustainable Growth Award for Leadership and Service in December 2023.
On the Wicomico County Council, he listed among his accomplishments helping secure new primary schools in Mardela and Fruitland and a county water and sewer master plan.
Hastings advanced unopposed from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.

He said his priorities are improving people's lives, advancing a cleaner planet and thriving natural resources, and strengthening democratic institutions, and that Maryland needs to address the cost of energy, groceries and housing.
